### How Awesome Is This Place
Author: Rev. Kyle Norman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/how-awesome-is-this-place-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Genesis 28:16-17
Points:
- God often reveals His presence in ordinary, routine moments when we least expect it.
- Jacob did nothing to engineer the encounter; he was merely fleeing from his brother in exhaustion.
- The dream was not about finding a magical geographical spot, but about God's gracious love and initiative.
- Believers are continuously sustained by God and live every moment enveloped in His presence through Christ.

### Living Fully Awake
Author: Mike DeVries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/living-fully-awake-homeword-july-25.html
Passage: Genesis 28:16
Points:
- People often speak as though God is distant and needs to suddenly arrive from elsewhere.
- Scripture affirms that God already fills all of creation and remains as near as our breath.
- Jacob's experience demonstrates that God was already right there, even when Jacob was completely unaware.
- The primary spiritual challenge is not locating God, but remaining awake and attentive to His active presence.
